verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented way to opt out of vendor telemetry or usage tracking. The 'telemetry' mentioned throughout refers to robot and device data the customer deliberately sends to Formant. Controls for which data streams upload, rate limits and low-bandwidth mode are adjacent data-ingestion settings, not an opt-out from product usage tracking, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
